Top Scientists Attend Chandigarh University International Faculty Program

Chandigarh University's 10th International Faculty Development Program has seen participation from 37 scientists recognized among the world's top 2%. The program aims to foster academic development and international collaboration. This event highlights the university's engagement with global research communities.
